summary: Agomab Therapeutics NV filed a Form 6-K on August 6, 2026, reporting half-year 2026 financial results and confirming its 2026 outlook. The press release highlights FDA alignment on the NOV-ERA Phase 2b study design for ontunisertib in fibrostenosing Crohn's disease, upcoming clinical data readouts, and a cash position of $252 million, including $208 million from its recent Nasdaq IPO, supporting a runway into early 2029. This is a routine business update with no special-situation event such as a merger, tender offer, or activist campaign. No deal terms, advisors, or board recommendations are relevant. Watch for anticipated clinical milestones in late 2026 and ongoing operational execution.
